exercise.summary: Re-issue every Certificate the way `cmctl renew` does (status condition Issuing=True, reason ManuallyTriggered). Issuance is where the controller applies a Certificate's defaults and private-key handling, so behaviour and CRD-default changes manifest here.

references.quote: `cmctl` allows you to manually trigger a renewal of a specific certificate.
apiutil.SetCertificateCondition(crt, crt.Generation, cmapi.CertificateConditionIssuing, cmmeta.ConditionTrue, "ManuallyTriggered", "Certificate re-issuance manually triggered")
Upon issuance, this field will be set to the value of the annotation

exercise.summary: Update every Ingress (an annotation the controller does not read): the controller's validating admission webhook validates the Ingress definition again and the controller re-syncs it, so changed validation and processing defaults manifest on existing Ingresses.

references.quote: The address to start an admission controller on to validate incoming ingresses.
